surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 5 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Qadr (The Power, Fate) is the 97th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 5 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم انا انزلناه في ليلة القدر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We sent it down on the Night of Glory

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: What will explain to you what that Night of Glory is

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرࣱ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ليلة القدر خير من الف شهر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ مِنْ كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: تنزل الملائكة والروح فيها باذن ربهم من كل امر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: on that night the angels and the Spirit descend again and again with their Lord’s permission on every task

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [there is] peace that night until the break of dawn
